# 27 — an X.509 provider

Hand-written fixture, 2026-09-13.

## Document

`"x509": {"trustStore": …}` with no condition.

## Expected

Issuer `""`; `{}`: everything, inexact, with a whole-grant caveat and an
`unmodelled-construct` anomaly whose Construct is `x509`.

## Why

Google: "An X.509-type identity provider represents a CA. It is trusted to
assert a client identity if the client has a certificate that chains up to
this CA." The credential is a certificate, whose subject this parser does
not model as token claims, and the trust anchor is a PEM certificate rather
than an issuer the registry knows. The grant is the whole provider,
declared an upper bound. The nested trust store is skipped by the reader
under its nesting bound, never read into the grant.
